doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Hospital, Miles Davis and Gil Evans
title: Healing, positive thinking and Dr. Weil's book
summary: Russell says music kept him from dwelling on illness and recommends a book by Andrew Weil.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Not dwell on it, absolutely. Take a weight, and along with that, developing a positive feeling that is healing. The book I’ve got downstairs is wonderful. A lot of people have that book.
It has a picture that looks something like you.
Oh yeah. Must be the Buddha!
He’s a man. Dr. Weill. W-e-i-l-l.
Oh, so you know who he’s talking about.
Yeah, Andrew Weill. He has several books.
Andrew Weill. I suggest it highly.
